name: SMHI meteorological observations (open data, metobs)
short: Swedish weather station observations from SMHI: temperature, wind, rain and more, hourly or better. CC BY 4.0, no key.
summary: SMHI, the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute, serves station observations through opendata-download-metobs.smhi.se/api/version/1.0. The tree runs parameter, then station, then period (latest-hour, latest-day, latest-months, corrected-archive). On 2026-11-07 a keyless call for parameter 1 (air temperature) listed 1,006 stations of which 231 are marked active, and the latest-hour call for Arvidsjaur A (station 159880) returned 5.2 C stamped 2026-11-07T18:00Z with quality flag G. Parameters include temperature, wind, humidity, pressure, precipitation and more, each its own numeric id. The unversioned path /version/latest did not resolve in a test; use version 1.0.

tasks: latest observation of a weather parameter at a Swedish station
station list per parameter with coordinates, owner, active flag and CORE or ADDITIONAL network

coverage.notes: Stations owned by SMHI and by other bodies (the owner field shows the body). measuringStations marks CORE (maintained) versus ADDITIONAL stations. Not every station measures every parameter.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07: station 159880 latest-hour value stamped 18:00Z; the call was made about 19:20Z. Update cadence depends on the parameter (the temperature parameter is 'once per hour').

latency.typical: Up to about an hour for hourly parameters

freshness.typical_age: About 1 hour on the one sample
freshness.notes: Parameter-specific; check the parameter summary field.

licensing.summary: SMHI's Terms of use page (updated 15 June 2026) says its open data follow Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 SE: you may copy, distribute and adapt, commercially too, naming SMHI as the source and stating any changes you made. Consequence-based weather warnings carry separate terms and are not part of this feed. AI training is not addressed.

time.method: Each record carries its own timestamp.
time.unknown: Timestamp is the provider's own stamp.

location.method: Fixed station or event coordinates in the feed.

content.method: Values carry a quality code (for example G) and stations are labelled CORE or ADDITIONAL.
content.unknown: The meaning of each quality code was not checked; ADDITIONAL stations are not described on the pages read.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments or official analysis, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

endpoints.notes: Call made. Value list with date (ms epoch), value, quality.
Call made. Station list with owner, height, lat/lon, active flag.

api.rate_limits: No numeric limit stated on the pages read.
api.notes: JSON, XML, CSV. Station and parameter ids are SMHI's own.
